```{r}
rm(list = ls())
Octo <- read.csv("C:\\Users\\bwvma\\OneDrive - ucsc.edu\\One Drive Back Up\\R-Studio\\Octodata\\FINAL DATA SET (BIOMASS CORRECTED).csv")

Corrected_Biomass <- Octo |>
  filter(Treatment != "Control") |>
  select(Distance.Value,Biomass,Shell.Length,Den.Number,Transect..N..E..S..W.) |> 
    mutate(Corrected.Biomass =
  0.06858280385283284374953 * Shell.Length^3 + 0.22034755586896595525026 * Shell.Length^2 + 0.20579305903708586256151 * Shell.Length) |> 
  select(Den.Number,Distance.Value,Corrected.Biomass,Transect..N..E..S..W.)


Median_Biomass <- median(Corrected_Biomass$Corrected.Biomass, na.rm = TRUE)

Biomass_Cats <- Corrected_Biomass |>
  select(Den.Number, Distance.Value, Transect..N..E..S..W.,Corrected.Biomass) |>
  group_by(Distance.Value) |>
  arrange(Distance.Value) |> 
  mutate(
    Biomass.cat = ifelse(
      Corrected.Biomass >= Median_Biomass,
      "Large",
      "Small"
    )
  )


Corrected_Biomass
Biomass_Cats
Median_Biomass
```
```{r}

counts <- Biomass_Cats |>
  count(Den.Number, Distance.Value, Biomass.cat,Transect..N..E..S..W.) |>
  ungroup() |> 
  complete(
    Den.Number = c("3","7","8","12"),
    Distance.Value = c(0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5),
    Biomass.cat = c("Small", "Large"),
    Transect..N..E..S..W. = c("North","East","South","West"),
    fill = list(n = 0)
  ) |>
  arrange(Den.Number,Transect..N..E..S..W., Distance.Value, Biomass.cat)

write_csv(counts,"counts.csv")
```

```{r}
mean_counts <- counts |>
  group_by(Distance.Value, Biomass.cat) |>
  summarise(mean_n = mean(n), .groups = "drop")

mean_counts

```
```{r}
ci_lines <- mean_counts |>
  group_by(Biomass.cat) |>
  summarise(
    mean = mean(mean_n),
    sd = sd(mean_n),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    t = qt(0.975, df = n - 1),
    ci_low = mean - se,
    ci_high = mean + se
  )

ci_lines
```
```{r}
model <- mean_counts |> 
  group_by(Biomass.cat) |> 
  do(
    model = lm(mean_n ~ poly(Distance.Value, 3), data = .)
  )
  
rsq_values <- model |> 
  mutate(
    r_squared = summary(model)$r.squared)|>

  select(Biomass.cat, r_squared)

rsq_values

```

```{r}
Graph_4 <- mean_counts |> 
  ggplot(
    aes(
      x=Distance.Value,
      y=mean_n,
      colour = Biomass.cat,
      
  ))+
  
   geom_rect(
    data = ci_lines |> 
      filter(Biomass.cat == "Large"),
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = ci_low,
    ymax = ci_high
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    fill = "#0072B2",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
    )+
  
  geom_rect(
    data = ci_lines |> 
      filter(Biomass.cat == "Small"),
    aes(
      xmin = -Inf,
    xmax = Inf,
    ymin = ci_low,
    ymax = ci_high
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    fill = "#D55E00",
    inherit.aes = FALSE
    )+
  
  
  geom_hline(
      yintercept = mean(mean_counts$mean_n[mean_counts$Biomass.cat == "Large"]),
      colour = "#0072B2")+
    
  geom_hline(
      yintercept = mean(mean_counts$mean_n[mean_counts$Biomass.cat == "Small"]),
      colour = "#D55E00")+
 
  geom_point()+
  geom_smooth(method = "lm",
              formula = y~ poly(x,3),
              se = FALSE)+
  scale_colour_manual(
    values=c("#0072B2","#D55E00")
  )+
  
  geom_text(
  data = rsq_values,
  aes(
    x = 2.4,
    y = ifelse(Biomass.cat == "Large", 0.2, 0.1),
    label = paste0("R² = ", round(r_squared, 3)),
    colour = Biomass.cat
  ),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  show.legend = FALSE
)+
  
  labs(
    x = "Distance from Den (m)",
    y = "Mean Count"
  ) +
  
  scale_colour_manual(
    values = c("Large" = "#0072B2", "Small" = "#D55E00"),
    name = "Size Category",
    labels = c("Larger than Median Biomass", "Smaller than Median Biomass")
  )+
  
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.6,0.11),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0))
  )
  
Graph_4

ggsave(Graph_4, filename="Calibri Graph 4 Curves Mean Count vs Distance From Den.png",dpi=600, height=5.32, width=6.5, units="in")
```

```{r}
model_cubic <- mean_counts |> 
  group_by(Biomass.cat) |> 
  do(
    model = lm(mean_n ~ poly(Distance.Value, 3), data = .)
  )

model_quadratic <- mean_counts |> 
  group_by(Biomass.cat) |> 
  do(
    model = lm(mean_n ~ poly(Distance.Value, 2), data = .)
  )

model_linear <- mean_counts |>
  group_by(Biomass.cat) |>
  do(
    model = lm(mean_n ~ poly(Distance.Value, 1), data = .)
  )

model_logisitic <- mean_counts |> 
  group_by(Biomass.cat) |> 
  do(
    model = lm(log(mean_n) ~ poly(Distance.Value, 3), data = .)
  )

sapply(model_cubic$model, BIC)
sapply(model_quadratic$model, BIC)
sapply(model_linear$model, BIC)
sapply(model_logisitic$model, BIC)
```
